category: Purview, DLP & data security for Copilot
title: Use a DLP policy to stop Copilot processing labeled content
problem: Highly confidential files should not be summarized by Copilot at all.
steps: Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom template > Custom policy.
On Locations, turn on 'Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat'.
Rule condition: Content contains > Sensitivity labels > 'Highly Confidential'.
Action: Prevent Copilot from processing content. Test in simulation mode first.
pitfalls: Labeled items still appear in citations — Copilot just doesn't use their content.
Email is covered only for messages sent on or after 1 January 2025; calendar invites aren't supported.
You can't combine sensitive information types and sensitivity labels in the same rule — create separate rules.
done_when: A DLP policy with the 'Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat' location and a 'Highly Confidential' label condition exists.
Simulation results were reviewed before the policy was turned on.
A test user cannot get Copilot to process a file with that label.

sources.title: Learn about the Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat DLP location

troubleshooting.symptom: Labeled files still appear as citations.
troubleshooting.fix: Expected: the policy stops Copilot from using the content, not from citing the item.

troubleshooting.symptom: An email or calendar invite with the label is still processed.
troubleshooting.cause: Email is covered only for messages sent on or after 1 January 2025; calendar invites aren't supported.
troubleshooting.fix: Expected limitation; don't treat it as a policy failure.

troubleshooting.symptom: You can't add sensitive information types to the label rule.
troubleshooting.fix: Create a separate rule; the two can't be combined in one rule.

rollback: Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Policies: switch the policy back to simulation mode or turn it off rather than deleting it.
Verify with a test prompt on a labeled item that Copilot uses the content again.
